description: Santo Antonio Hydropower Plant Case Study: Data and FAHP solution is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors José Roberto Ribas. This zip file made with 18 Excel spreadsheets contains data and solution for the risk assessment of the Santo Antonio hydroelectric power plant. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
